description:
What one plan actually pays, item by item from its own Benefit Schedule: full cover or the published cap on
    room and board, hospital charges, surgeon's fee, imaging, cancer treatment and psychiatric care, plus the annual
    and lifetime limits, room class, territory, extras and a coverage score. Use it for "what does this cover", "is
    surgery covered in full", "does it include outpatient".
